verdict.rationale: Paddle's evidence centers on developer-integrated checkout (Paddle.js overlay/inline checkout embedded in a website or app) and dashboard-created transactions for internal use, but there is no evidence of a standalone, no-code 'shareable payment link' a founder could generate and immediately distribute (e.g., via email or social media) without any integration work. The closest hints — overlay checkout needing 'minimal frontend coding' and dashboard-created transactions — still imply some setup/integration rather than a pure link-generation flow.
